title: NPC Template
description: Schema for a procgen NPC template. Per ADR-0014. World generation instantiates this template to produce many concrete NPC instances at world creation, each with a procedurally generated URN. Lives in npc_templates/<template_id>/data.json.

display_name.description: Designer-facing template name. Procgen instances use generated names from name_patterns.

name_patterns.description: Procedural name generation. Either fixed pool or pattern-based. If both are provided, 'pool' overrides 'pattern': names are sampled from the pool directly. Use 'pattern' alone when names should be composed from the referenced culture's name tables.

pool.description: Pool of complete names to draw from. The procgen system samples without replacement per sub_faction to avoid duplicates locally.

pattern.description: Generative pattern. Available placeholders for NPC name patterns: {first} (sampled from the referenced culture's first_names_* tables, gender-aware if NPC has gender), {family_name} (sampled from family_names), {epithet} (sampled from epithets), {place_root} (sampled from place_roots). Example: '{first} {family_name}', '{first} of {place_root}', '{first} the {epithet}'.

roles.description: Role URNs assigned to every instance from this template.

drive_distributions.description: Drive weight distributions. Each instance samples a weight from the range for each listed drive.

allowlist.description: Permitted tool calls. Same as NPC schema; applies to every instance.

personality_seeds.description: Pool of personality prose snippets. The procgen system samples one or composes from multiple. Each instance's personality is recorded permanently in the world DB.

memory_seed_patterns.description: Templated memory seeds. Each string may reference template parameters via $name placeholders, substituted at instance creation. Documented parameters: $sub_faction (URN of the instance's sub_faction), $culture (URN of the instance's culture), $birth_year (sampled int), $service_years (sampled int, for soldier/elder templates), $original_name (pre-corruption name, for void_touched templates). Example: 'Born in $sub_faction. Remembers the long winter of three years past.' Validator accepts the syntax; runtime substitution emits errors for undefined parameters.

count_per_sub_faction.description: How many instances to generate per sub_faction when this template is referenced in a sub_faction's npc_templates_used.

combat_stat_ranges.description: Stat ranges. Each instance samples one value per stat.
